name: Dedicated Melee Slot
description: Carry a pistol and a melee weapon at once (Clonedivers 4-player co-op hardened build of v1.5.2). Pick machete, stun-lance, saber, stun-baton, hatchet or shovel from the loadout card box (packed at non-colliding patch_920; requires Bingus Shared Loader v15+) or melee-slot-weapon.txt; tap your secondary key again while drawn to toggle.
